class.name: BulletArea
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A dedicated node for handling bullet collision detection in UT-Godot-Engine. Used together with [Bullet] nodes to manage collisions with the player, damage processing, invincibility frames, and more.
class.description:
This node is used by placing it as a child node of a [Bullet] node without writing a separate script. It serves as a specialized collision detection node that replaces [Area2D].
[b]Example Scene Structure[/b] [codeblock] Bullet (Bullet script) ├── Sprite2D ├── BulletArea (bullet_path: "../") │ └── CollisionShape2D └── ... [/codeblock]
[b]Notes[/b] • The [member bullet_path] must point to a valid [Bullet] node. • Collision detection is handled automatically, so no additional configuration is necessary.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: is_player_hit
method.description: Returns whether the player is currently colliding with this [BulletArea]. This method internally tracks collision state, returning true if the player is colliding, and false otherwise.

members.member: The path to the [Bullet] node to connect to. This node automatically synchronizes damage, invincibility frames, KR values, and more from the bullet. Must point to a valid [Bullet] type node.
